{{Top|leg}}
A '''Sector Headquarters''', also named '''Sector HQ'''<ref name="RASB">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> or '''Sector Force Headquarters''', was the base from which [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operations in a given [[Sector/Legends|sector]] were commanded.<ref name="AoR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> [[Generis base]] contained the [[Atrivis Sector Force]]'s Sector Headquarters, led by [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]] [[Travia Chan/Legends|Travia Chan]].<ref name="RASB" />
